name: fig06-orchestration
description: Fig 6 — orchestration patterns (conceptual): (a) multi-timestepping temporal processes each updating at their own interval over a shared store, (b) a workflow DAG of step processes over intermediate stores, and (c) event-driven graph rewrite. A draft drawing composite backing the hand-composed figure_6.svg; it is not simulated.
